Fulbright New Zealand info-session
9/07/2025
Have you always wanted to carry out research overseas? A Fulbright Award could take you to a leading institution in the United States.
Fulbright NZ Scholar Awards are for New Zealand academics, artists or professionals to lecture and/or conduct research at US institutions.
Want to know more? Register for an online information session covering the Fulbright NZ Scholar Awards.
Tuesday 29 July 5.30–6.30 pm (Microsoft Teams)
The session will explain what the awards involve and how to apply, so come along and discover what Fulbright has to offer!

Scam email
30/01/2025
We are aware some people are receiving scam emails relating to University of Auckland scholarships and accommodation. The email address scholarships.uoa@gmail.com does
not
belong to the University of Auckland Scholarships Office.
Top TV screenwriter wins creative writing prize
11/11/2024
A dark comedy by successful screenwriter Gavin Strawhan has won the University of Auckland
Phoenix Prize for Creative Writing
.
The Prize recognises the student in the Master of Creative Writing degree at Waipapa Taumata Rau, University of Auckland who has completed, in the year of the award, a manuscript of high quality with strong potential to succeed commercially. The Prize aims to facilitate the completion of that manuscript towards publication.
